about: Ranked city visual defects for issue #1683. Severity follows docs/CITY_VISUAL_DIRECTION.md section 6. scripts/city-review.py audit <this file> --gate fails while a critical or major defect is open.

defects.title: City reads as detached one-storey cottages on lawn; no street has a wall
defects.note: Solved for the pilot block (city_block_roman): tenement terraces on abutting lots. Aurelia Magna still exports 0.8 m frontage gaps and plain homes; slice 3 moves its insula blocks onto lay_tenement_block.

defects.title: Flat skyline: every home one height, nothing between a cottage and the temple
defects.note: Pilot block has two to four storeys grouped by district cell. Open until the flagship city uses it.

defects.title: Shaded walls turn slate blue
defects.note: Street bounce fill on shaded mineral, ceramic and timber building surfaces; limewash classified as mineral instead of by brightness.

defects.title: Lawn between town houses and in courts inside the walls
defects.note: Building density in the terrain cover mask turns crowded ground into beaten earth and clears its grass.

defects.title: An imperial capital behind a timber palisade
defects.note: Masonry wall style (wall_segment and wall_gate, "masonry"): a crenellated stone curtain and a stone gatehouse with timber leaves, for Rome and Carthage. Used by map_rome and map_carthage; Aurelia Magna keeps its palisade until it is converted.

defects.title: Forum and plazas are bare grey rectangles
defects.note: Flagstone road style for squares; the Forum of map_rome has statues, basilicas down its long sides and temples closing its ends. Aurelia Magna not converted yet.

defects.title: Basilica, curia, baths and library are market stalls
defects.note: Marketplace styles portico and basilica: a colonnaded walk with shops, and a clerestory hall behind a two-storey colonnade. Aurelia Magna not converted yet.

defects.title: The sacred mountain is a smooth green dome and the crags are cones
Garden houses of the west quarter stand apart with open lawn between them
defects.note: Wants garden walls between lots; a P4 dressing kit.

defects.title: There is no Punic city: the showcase is eight buildings in a stockade
defects.note: map_carthage: the headland city with the round war harbour and the admiral's island, the merchant basin, agora, Byrsa, tophet, tall-house quarters and the isthmus wall.

defects.title: The arena's banded cliff ring stands in for a horizon
defects.note: map_carthage is reviewed as a map, with the gulf and the lagoon out to the horizon, not inside the arena's cliff ring.

defects.title: Punic houses are well characterised but identical in height
defects.note: The Punic tall house: eight variants of two to four storeys on the tenement lot, grouped by district.
